tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: yang gsang thugs kyi phur gcig las: las byang phrin las 'dus pa bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra na mo: snying po ye shes dbyings nas bzhengs: rdo rje gzhon nur phyag bgyis nas: bit+yot+ta ma 'bum sde yi: snying po don bsdus phrin las bsdeb: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes: sngon 'gro sbyor ba tshogs gsag pa: dang po dben pa'i gnas dag tu: sku gsung thugs kyi rten bkram zhing: dkyil 'khor bzhengs la sgrub rdzas bkod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsham: rnal 'byor pa rnams stan bder 'dug: gnyis pa gnas bdag mchod pa dang: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mdun du bsgom: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan bdun 'bul: bka' bsgo mtshams bcad brda phyag 'tshal: sku gsung thugs kyi bshags pa bya: bsgrub par dam bca' byin chen dbab: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa rnams: spyi chings bzhin du blta bar bya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting gsum ni: hūm̐: rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod: mtshon cha sngon po 'bar ba ni: nam mkha'i dkyil nas thig pa shar: dharma dhā tu shud+dhe ā: ma hā su kha āt+ma ko3 haṃ: bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐: eḥyaṃḥraḥsuṃḥkeṃḥraṃḥhūm̐ḥtiḥpaṃḥhaḥbh+rūm̐: hūm̐: 'byung ba chen po mkha' las bab: kun khyab nam mkha' stobs chen rlung: khrag mtsho zhing gi sa gzhi gdal: keng rus ri rab me chen 'bar: hūm̐ las srung ba'i gur chen dang: dur khrod rab 'jigs sa gzhi'i dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma rgya gram steng: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang: phyi ni rin chen rgyan dang ldan: nang ni dur khrod chas kyis brjid: badz+ra ra ti rdo rje'i brag: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen 'bar ba'i gdan: lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i khrir: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: dbus su hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: dbu skra spyir bcings rdo rje'i tog:

thod skam rin chen rtse bran can: dang pos rtse dgu sdigs mdzub phyar: bar pas rtse lnga kha ṭ+wāṃ gsor: 'og mas ri rab phur pa bsgril: zhabs bzhis lha chen pho mo mnan: gshog brgyangs dur khrod chas kyis 'jigs: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: ut+pal dung dmar stob pas 'khyud: me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs: phur bu'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: thugs kar 'od kyi gur khyim nang: rdo rje sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i: thugs kar rin chen nyi zla'i steng: rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po: nyi mar 'bru dgu g.yo med bsgom: rta mgrin pad+ma 'dzin pas srung: yab yum gsang ba rdo rje dang: pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba yi: rjes chags byang sems hūm̐ yig bcu: steng 'og phyogs mtshams 'phros pa las: steng du hūm̐ kār sgra 'byin ma: sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: shar du rnam rgyal snyems ma ni: sprul pa stag dang bya rgod mgo: shar lhor dbyug sngon sder mo ni: sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo: lho phyogs gshin rje dur khrod bdag: sprul pa sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo: lho nub mi g.yo gtun khung ma: sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: nub phyogs rta mgrin gtum mo ni: sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: nub byang 'dod rgyal mda' snyems ni: sprul pa spyang ki khra yi mgo: byang du bdud rtsi rlung 'byin ni: sprul pa seng ge pha wang mgo: byang shar khams gsum gsod byed ni: sprul pa dom dang sre mong mgo: 'og phyogs stobs chen skul ma ni: sprul pa dred dang byi ba'i mgo: sprul pa'i khro chen yab yum rnams: zhal gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen: dur khrod chas brgyad me klong bzhugs: bskal pa'i me ltar gsal bar bsgom: zla gam nang du sprul pa'i sras: sku stod khro bo 'jigs pa la: sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal: me dpung dbus su skar ltar 'khrugs: sgo bzhir sprul pa'i khro mo bzhi: phyi rol dam can tshogs rnams gsal:

oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭ: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: ye nas dag pa'i sku gsung thugs: ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid du: byin gyis brlab cing dbang bskur ro: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'di la dgongs: ye shes dkyil 'khor 'grub par mdzod: badz+ra sa mā dza: ye shes dkyil 'khor mdun byon bsam: hūm̐: srid pa phur bu'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol: ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas 'dir: ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: he ru ka dpal lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las skur bzhengs pa'i: he ru ka dpal tshogs rnams la: gus pa'i yid kyis gar dang bcas: brkyang bskum stabs kyis phyag bgyi 'o: a ti bhū ho: pra ti bhū ho: hūm̐: ru tra bsgral pa las byung ba'i: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra: he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul: ma hā puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: hūm̐: gti mug bsgral pa'i sha chen dang: 'dod chags bsgral pa'i khrag chen dang: zhe sdang bsgral pa'i rus chen rnams: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: ye shes lnga rdzogs sgrub pa'i rdzas: he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: mtshan don sbyar zhing dngos grub blang: lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la:

rnal 'byor can gyis hūm̐ bsgom zhing: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dngos grub blangs: lce la thim pas mchog thob 'gyur: sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: dung chen snod du ru tra bsgral: dmar chen rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo: 'khor ba stongs pa'i rak+ta 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: hūm̐: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod nang du: srid gsum bsgral pa'i ba liṃ ta: dpal gyi gtor ma chen po 'di: he ru ka yi tshogs la 'bul: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: chos dbyings yum gyi bha ga'i klong: bde chen thabs kyi rdo rjes srub: bde stong 'du 'bral med pa 'di: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ma hā mu dra bhañja mok+ṣa pū dza ho: hūm̐: nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs: lha 'am 'on te bdud kyang rung: e yi dkyil 'khor chen por bsgral: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal du bstab: ma hā ru dra khā hi: 'jigs pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo yis: hūm̐: ye shes sku ni gzi brjid 'bar: grags stong gsung gis 'jig rten g.yo: snying rje'i shugs kyis stong gsum bsgral: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi dge bcu bsgral khro chen bcu: phar phyin bcu las bzhengs pa'i yum: thabs shes sku sprul za gsod tshogs: phyogs bcu'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: thugs rje'i thabs kyis bsgral ba'i phyir: snying rje 'dus pa'i kī la ya: sras mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpal gyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i: tshad med rnam bzhi'i sgo ma bzhi: phyi 'khor skyong ba pho nya'i tshogs: phrin las sgrub phyir phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas dzap kyi rim pa ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ: drag po spyi dril snying po ni: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: skabs su dzap bstod mchod pa bya: rjes kyi bya ba tshogs skong dang: bsgral bstab longs spyod lhag ma gtang: bskul zhing chad mdo brtan ma skyong:

bro brdung tshe 'gugs mchod bstod bsdu: lhar ldang smon lam bkra shis dang: rgyun spyod spyi chings bzhin du bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈ sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur gling pas karma'i dam can brag nas spyan drangs pa'i gnam lcags phur sgrom rgya mdud gru gsum nang*/ lcags kyi byang bu gu ru'i phyag bris la ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa dang bcas legs par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pra dz+nyā dh+wa dza'o/// /
